Second transcription's note: The published per-person eic_se interface supplies the applicable Part 1 or Part 2 amount. Statutory employees, farm and partnership income, clergy, church employee income, and other exempt or special self-employment cases are excluded by the supplied screens.

Ruling: model error; i1040gi p. 47, Worksheet B: "Use this worksheet if you answered “Yes” to Step 5, question 2." and line 4b: "If line 4b is zero or less, STOP You can’t take the credit." The candidate has no shown_when and shows a nonzero amount on 328 completed returns where the project hides the line (shown_when eic.show_wsb4b); a nonzero amount on a line the filer does not reach is a model error (README, skipped-line rule). | 5 | eic.died_2025, eic.h_se_screen, s8812.combat_pay, sa.excluded_income, scope.other_income, scope.other_line16, scope.schedule1, sd.other_forms | eic.died_2025, eic.h_se_screen, scope.other_line16 |
| 6 (eic.line6) | eic.died_2025, eic.h_se_screen, s8812.combat_pay, sa.excluded_income, scope.other_income, scope.other_line16, scope.schedule1, sd.other_forms | eic.died_2025, eic.h_se_screen, scope.other_line16 |

```yaml
lines:
  - id: eic.step5_line1
    printed: "(Step 5, 1)"
    label: "Enter the amount from Form 1040 or 1040-SR, line 1z."
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: copy, from: f1040.line1z}
    refuses: [scope.schedule1, scope.other_income]
    cite: "i1040gi (2025; 2026-02-25), pp. 42–43, Step 5 and Clergy."
  - id: eic.step5_line2
    printed: "(Step 5, 2)"
    label: "Enter the Medicaid waiver payment amounts excluded from income on Schedule 1, line 8s, unless you choose to include these amounts in earned income, in which case enter -0-."
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: param, ref: ss.zero}
    refuses: [scope.other_income, scope.schedule1]
    cite: "i1040gi (2025; 2026-02-25), p. 42, Step 5, line 2."
    note: "Medicaid waiver payments are excluded by the supplied scope screens."
  - id: eic.step5_line3
    printed: "(Step 5, 3)"
    label: "Subtract line 2 from line 1."
    type: Dollars
    expr: {op: subtract, from: eic.step5_line1, take: eic.step5_line2}
    cite: "i1040gi (2025; 2026-02-25), p. 42, Step 5, line 3."
  - id: eic.step5_line4
    printed: "(Step 5, 4)"
    label: "Enter all of your nontaxable combat pay if you elect to include it in earned income."
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: param, ref: ss.zero}
    refuses: [s8812.combat_pay]
    cite: "i1040gi (2025; 2026-02-25), pp. 42–43, Step 5, line 4 and Combat pay, nontaxable."
    note: "Combat pay is outside the supplied screening scope; no election or amount is invented."
  - id: eic.earned_income
    printed: "(Step 5, 5)"
    label: "Add lines 3 and 4. This is your earned income."
    type: Dollars
    expr: {op: sum, of: [eic.step5_line3, eic.step5_line4]}
    cite: "i1040gi (2025; 2026-02-25), p. 42, Step 5, line 5."
  - id: eic.wsb_4b
    printed: "4b"
    label: "Combine lines 1e, 2c, 3, and 4a. This is your total earned income."
    type: Dollars
    expr: {op: sum, of: [eic.h_self_employment_income, eic.earned_income]}
    refuses: [scope.schedule1, eic.h_se_screen]
    cite: "i1040gi (2025; 2026-02-25), p. 47, Worksheet B, Parts 1–4."
    note: "The published per-person eic_se interface supplies the applicable Part 1 or Part 2 amount. Statutory employees, farm and partnership income, clergy, church employee income, and other exempt or special self-employment cases are excluded by the supplied screens."
  - id: eic.wsb_6
    printed: "6 (eic.wsb_6)"
    label: "Enter your total earned income from Part 4, line 4b."
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr:
      op: choose
      alternatives:
        - guard: {op: test, eq: [eic.h_b_income_ok, {const: true}]}
          then: eic.h_b_positive
        - guard: {op: test, eq: [eic.h_b_income_ok, {const: false}]}
          then: eic.h_zero
    cite: "i1040gi (2025; 2026-02-25), pp. 47–48, Worksheet B, lines 4b–6."
    note: "Zero represents the no-credit STOP before line 6; on the continuing branch the positive line 4b amount is preserved."
  - id: eic.line1
    printed: "1"
    label: "Enter your earned income from Step 5."
    type: Dollars
    expr: {op: copy, from: eic.earned_income}
    cite: "i1040gi (2025; 2026-02-25), p. 46, Worksheet A, line 1."
  - id: eic.line2
    printed: "2"
    label: "Look up the amount on line 1 above in the EIC Table to find the credit."
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr:
      op: choose
      alternatives:
        - guard: {op: test, lt: [eic.line1, {param: eic.table_start}]}
          then: eic.h_zero
        - guard: {op: test, ge: [eic.line1, eic.h_limit]}
          then: eic.h_zero
        - guard:
            op: test
            all:
              - {op: test, ge: [eic.line1, {param: eic.table_start}]}
              - {op: test, lt: [eic.line1, eic.h_limit]}
          then: eic.h_a_lookup
    cite: "i1040gi (2025; 2026-02-25), pp. 42, 46, 49–60, Step 5 question 3, Worksheet A line 2, and EIC Table."
    note: "The printed table starts at $1 and gives no row for smaller amounts. This transcription uses zero below that first row; no positive credit is inferred there."
  - id: eic.line3
    printed: "3"
    label: "Enter the amount from Form 1040 or 1040-SR, line 11b."
    type: Dollars
    expr: {op: copy, from: f1040.line11b}
    cite: "i1040gi (2025; 2026-02-25), p. 46, Worksheet A, line 3."
  - id: eic.line4
    printed: "4"
    label: "Are the amounts on lines 3 and 1 the same?"

    expr: {op: test, eq: [eic.line3, eic.line1]}

  - id: eic.line5
    printed: "5"
    label: "Look up the amount on line 3 in the EIC Table to find the credit."
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr:

          then: eic.h_zero
    shown_when: eic.h_a_use_agi

    note: "The hidden zero is a representation of a skipped blank, not a credit used in the minimum."
  - id: eic.line6
    printed: "6 (eic.line6)"
    label: "This is your earned income credit."
    type: NonNegDollars

        - guard:

          then: eic.h_a_min
    cite: "i1040gi (2025; 2026-02-25), p. 46, Worksheet A, lines 2–6."

  - id: eic.self_employed
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Were you self-employed at any time in 2025?"
    type: Bool
    expr: {op: test, gt: [s1.sc_count, {const: 0, type: Count}]}
    refuses: [scope.schedule1, eic.h_se_screen]
    cite: "i1040gi (2025; 2026-02-25), p. 42, Step 5, question 2."
    note: "Within the declared scope, Schedule C businesses determine the Worksheet B route, including businesses with a loss or zero profit."
  - id: eic.eligible
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "You can’t take the credit."
    type: Bool
    expr:

                - {op: test, lt: [eic.earned_income, eic.h_limit]}

                - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_b_income_ok, {const: true}]}
    cite: "i1040gi (2025; 2026-02-25), pp. 40–42 and 47, Steps 1–5 and Worksheet B lines 4b–5."
    note: "True means the applicable eligibility flow reaches the credit lookup; the lookup may still produce zero."
  - id: eic.credit
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Enter this amount on Form 1040 or 1040-SR, line 27a."
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr:
      op: choose
      alternatives:
        - guard: {op: test, eq: [eic.eligible, {const: false}]}
          then: eic.h_zero
        - guard:
            op: test
            all:

    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Check the box on line 27c if you do not want to claim the earned income credit or if you have been instructed to check the box in the instructions for line 27a."
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      any:

          all:
            - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_agi_ok, {const: true}]}
            - {op: test, eq: [household.all_eic_ssn, {const: false}]}
        - op: test

          all:
            - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_step4_home_reached, {const: true}]}
            - {op: test, eq: [eic.us_home, {const: false}]}
        - op: test
          all:
            - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_step4_home_reached, {const: true}]}
            - {op: test, eq: [eic.us_home, {const: true}]}
            - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_joint, {const: false}]}
            - {op: test, eq: [eic.qc_of_another, {const: true}]}
        - op: test
          all:
            - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_pre_income_ok, {const: true}]}
            - {op: test, eq: [eic.self_employed, {const: true}]}
            - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_b_income_ok, {const: false}]}
        - op: test
          all:

            - {op: test, eq: [eic.self_employed, {const: false}]}

        - op: test
          all:
            - {op: test, eq: [eic.eligible, {const: true}]}
            - {op: test, eq: [eic.self_employed, {const: true}]}
            - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_b_line7, {const: 0}]}
    cite: "i1040gi (2025; 2026-02-25), pp. 40–44 and 46–48, instructions to check line 27c."
    note: "Only instructed checks within the screened scope are computed. A voluntary decision not to claim the credit cannot be determined from the closed input interface. A zero resulting only from the later AGI comparison does not itself instruct a check."
  - id: eic.separated_box
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Check the box in the Dependents section that discusses the special rule for separated spouses."
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      all:
        - {op: test, eq: [household.married, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_joint, {const: false}]}
        - {op: test, gt: [eic.h_children, {const: 0, type: Count}]}
        - op: test
          any:
            - {op: test, eq: [eic.same_home, {const: false}]}
            - {op: test, eq: [eic.legally_separated, {const: true}]}
    cite: "i1040gi (2025; 2026-02-25), pp. 41 and 44, Step 3 question 6 and Special rule for separated spouses."
    note: "The specific definition on page 44 limits this checkbox to married filers not filing jointly; the broader placement of the checkbox instruction in Step 3 question 6 is read in that context."
  - id: eic.clergy
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Check the box on line 27b."
    type: Bool
    expr: {op: test, eq: [{const: false}, {const: true}]}
    refuses: [scope.schedule1, eic.h_se_screen]
    cite: "i1040gi (2025; 2026-02-25), p. 43, Line 27b and Clergy."
    note: "Clergy and church employee cases are screened out; the supported case has no line 27b check."

  - id: eic.h_zero
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "You can’t take the credit."
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: param, ref: ss.zero}
    cite: "i1040gi (2025; 2026-02-25), pp. 40–42, STOP instructions."
  - id: eic.h_se_screen_count
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Members of the clergy, and people with church employee income."
    type: Count
    expr:
      op: sum_over
      collection: person
      field: person.one
      where: {op: test, eq: [person.se_screen, {const: true}]}
    cite: "i1040gi (2025; 2026-02-25), pp. 42–43 and 47, self-employment special cases."
  - id: eic.h_se_screen
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Self-employment cases requiring special treatment."
    type: Bool
    expr: {op: test, gt: [eic.h_se_screen_count, {const: 0, type: Count}]}
    cite: "i1040gi (2025; 2026-02-25), pp. 42–43 and 47."
  - id: eic.h_self_employment_income
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "If you are married filing a joint return, include your spouse’s amounts, if any, with yours."
    type: Dollars
    expr: {op: sum_over, collection: person, field: person.eic_se}
    cite: "i1040gi (2025; 2026-02-25), p. 47, Worksheet B, Parts 1–2."
  - id: eic.h_children
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Children who meet the conditions to be your qualifying child for the purpose of claiming the EIC."
    type: Count
    expr:
      op: sum_over
      collection: dependent
      field: dependent.one
      where: {op: test, eq: [dependent.eic_child, {const: true}]}
    cite: "i1040gi (2025; 2026-02-25), pp. 41 and 43–45, qualifying child rules."
  - id: eic.h_ssn_children
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Qualifying children you have who have valid SSNs."
    type: Count
    expr:
      op: sum_over
      collection: dependent
      field: dependent.one
      where: {op: test, eq: [dependent.eic_ssn_child, {const: true}]}
    cite: "i1040gi (2025; 2026-02-25), pp. 45–46, Social security number and Worksheet A."
  - id: eic.h_joint
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Are you filing a joint return for 2025?"
    type: Bool
    expr: {op: test, eq: [f1040.status, {const: "mfj"}]}
    cite: "i1040gi (2025; 2026-02-25), pp. 41–42, Steps 3–4."
  - id: eic.h_married_separate
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Are you a married taxpayer whose filing status is married filing separately or head of household?"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      all:
        - {op: test, eq: [household.married, {const: true}]}
        - op: test
          any:
            - {op: test, eq: [f1040.status, {const: "mfs"}]}
            - {op: test, eq: [f1040.status, {const: "hoh"}]}
    cite: "i1040gi (2025; 2026-02-25), p. 41, Steps 3–4."
  - id: eic.h_limit0_other
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "No qualifying children who have valid SSNs."
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: param, ref: eic.limit0.other}
    cite: "i1040gi (2025; 2026-02-25), pp. 40 and 42."
  - id: eic.h_limit1_other
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "1 qualifying child who has a valid SSN."
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: param, ref: eic.limit1.other}
    cite: "i1040gi (2025; 2026-02-25), pp. 40 and 42."
  - id: eic.h_limit2_other
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "2 qualifying children who have valid SSNs."
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: param, ref: eic.limit2.other}
    cite: "i1040gi (2025; 2026-02-25), pp. 40 and 42."
  - id: eic.h_limit3_other
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "3 or more qualifying children who have valid SSNs."
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: param, ref: eic.limit3.other}
    cite: "i1040gi (2025; 2026-02-25), pp. 40 and 42."
  - id: eic.h_limit0_joint
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "No qualifying children who have valid SSNs, if married filing jointly."
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: param, ref: eic.limit0.joint}
    cite: "i1040gi (2025; 2026-02-25), pp. 40 and 42."
  - id: eic.h_limit1_joint
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "1 qualifying child who has a valid SSN, if married filing jointly."
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: param, ref: eic.limit1.joint}
    cite: "i1040gi (2025; 2026-02-25), pp. 40 and 42."
  - id: eic.h_limit2_joint
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "2 qualifying children who have valid SSNs, if married filing jointly."
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: param, ref: eic.limit2.joint}
    cite: "i1040gi (2025; 2026-02-25), pp. 40 and 42."
  - id: eic.h_limit3_joint
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "3 or more qualifying children who have valid SSNs, if married filing jointly."
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: param, ref: eic.limit3.joint}
    cite: "i1040gi (2025; 2026-02-25), pp. 40 and 42."
  - id: eic.h_other_limit
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Income limit for the number of qualifying children who have valid SSNs."
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr:
      op: choose
      alternatives:
        - guard: {op: test, eq: [eic.h_ssn_children, {const: 0, type: Count}]}
          then: eic.h_limit0_other
        - guard: {op: test, eq: [eic.h_ssn_children, {const: 1, type: Count}]}
          then: eic.h_limit1_other
        - guard: {op: test, eq: [eic.h_ssn_children, {const: 2, type: Count}]}
          then: eic.h_limit2_other
        - guard: {op: test, ge: [eic.h_ssn_children, {const: 3, type: Count}]}
          then: eic.h_limit3_other
    cite: "i1040gi (2025; 2026-02-25), pp. 40, 42 and 47."
  - id: eic.h_joint_limit
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Income limit if married filing jointly."
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr:
      op: choose
      alternatives:
        - guard: {op: test, eq: [eic.h_ssn_children, {const: 0, type: Count}]}
          then: eic.h_limit0_joint
        - guard: {op: test, eq: [eic.h_ssn_children, {const: 1, type: Count}]}
          then: eic.h_limit1_joint
        - guard: {op: test, eq: [eic.h_ssn_children, {const: 2, type: Count}]}
          then: eic.h_limit2_joint
        - guard: {op: test, ge: [eic.h_ssn_children, {const: 3, type: Count}]}
          then: eic.h_limit3_joint
    cite: "i1040gi (2025; 2026-02-25), pp. 40, 42 and 47."
  - id: eic.h_limit
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Income limit."
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr:
      op: choose
      alternatives:
        - guard: {op: test, eq: [eic.h_joint, {const: true}]}
          then: eic.h_joint_limit
        - guard: {op: test, eq: [eic.h_joint, {const: false}]}
          then: eic.h_other_limit
    cite: "i1040gi (2025; 2026-02-25), pp. 40, 42 and 47."
  - id: eic.h_agi_ok
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Is the amount on Form 1040 or 1040-SR, line 11b, less than the applicable limit?"
    type: Bool
    expr: {op: test, lt: [f1040.line11b, eic.h_limit]}
    cite: "i1040gi (2025; 2026-02-25), p. 40, Step 1, question 1."
    note: "Step 1’s preliminary count of children with valid SSNs is resolved using the qualifying-child count established in Step 3."
  - id: eic.h_capital_gain
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "If line 7a is a loss, enter -0-."
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: subtract_floor0, from: f1040.line7a, take: {const: 0}}
    cite: "i1040gi (2025; 2026-02-25), p. 40, Step 2, question 1."
  - id: eic.h_investment_income
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Investment Income."
    type: Dollars
    expr: {op: sum, of: [f1040.line2a, f1040.line2b, f1040.line3b, eic.h_capital_gain]}
    refuses: [scope.schedule1, scope.other_income, scope.other_line16, sd.other_forms]
    cite: "i1040gi (2025; 2026-02-25), p. 40, Step 2."
  - id: eic.h_step3_reached
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Go to Step 3."
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      all:
        - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_agi_ok, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [household.all_eic_ssn, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, le: [eic.h_investment_income, {param: eic.investment_limit}]}
    refuses: [scope.other_income, sa.excluded_income]
    cite: "i1040gi (2025; 2026-02-25), p. 40, Steps 1–2."
    note: "Form 2555 and nonresident alien cases are refused through the supplied broader scope screens, rather than treated as supported exceptions."
  - id: eic.h_child_path_ok
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Skip Step 4; go to Step 5."
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      all:
        - {op: test, gt: [eic.h_children, {const: 0, type: Count}]}
        - op: test
          any:
            - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_joint, {const: true}]}
            - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_married_separate, {const: false}]}
            - {op: test, eq: [eic.same_home, {const: false}]}
            - {op: test, eq: [eic.legally_separated, {const: true}]}
    cite: "i1040gi (2025; 2026-02-25), p. 41, Step 3, questions 1–5."
  - id: eic.h_age_count
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Born after December 31, 1960, and before January 2, 2001."
    type: Count
    expr:
      op: sum_over
      collection: person
      field: person.one
      where:
        op: test
        all:
          - {op: test, eq: [person.born_before_2001, {const: true}]}
          - {op: test, eq: [person.born_after_1960, {const: true}]}
          - op: test
            any:
              - {op: test, eq: [person.role, {const: "taxpayer"}]}
              - {op: test, eq: [f1040.status, {const: "mfj"}]}
    cite: "i1040gi (2025; 2026-02-25), pp. 41–42, Step 4, question 2."
  - id: eic.h_age_ok
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Were you, or your spouse if filing a joint return, at least age 25 but under age 65 at the end of 2025?"
    type: Bool
    expr: {op: test, gt: [eic.h_age_count, {const: 0, type: Count}]}
    refuses: [eic.died_2025]
    cite: "i1040gi (2025; 2026-02-25), pp. 41–42, Step 4, question 2."
  - id: eic.h_step4_home_reached
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Was your main home, and your spouse’s if filing a joint return, in the United States for more than half of 2025?"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      all:
        - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_step3_reached, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_children, {const: 0, type: Count}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_married_separate, {const: false}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_age_ok, {const: true}]}
    cite: "i1040gi (2025; 2026-02-25), pp. 41–42, Step 4, questions 1–3."
  - id: eic.h_pre_income_ok
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Go to Step 5."
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      all:
        - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_step3_reached, {const: true}]}
        - op: test
          any:
            - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_joint, {const: true}]}
            - {op: test, eq: [eic.qc_of_another, {const: false}]}
        - op: test
          any:
            - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_child_path_ok, {const: true}]}
            - op: test
              all:
                - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_step4_home_reached, {const: true}]}
                - {op: test, eq: [eic.us_home, {const: true}]}
                - op: test
                  any:
                    - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_joint, {const: true}]}
                    - {op: test, eq: [sa.dependent, {const: false}]}
    cite: "i1040gi (2025; 2026-02-25), pp. 41–42, Steps 3–4."
    note: "For a nonjoint return, sa.dependent supplies Step 4 question 6 within the scope excluding dual-status aliens. Joint returns skip that question."
  - id: eic.h_b_income_ok
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "If line 4b is zero or less, you can’t take the credit."
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      all:
        - {op: test, gt: [eic.wsb_4b, {const: 0}]}
        - {op: test, lt: [eic.wsb_4b, eic.h_limit]}
    cite: "i1040gi (2025; 2026-02-25), p. 47, Worksheet B, lines 4b–5."
  - id: eic.h_b_positive
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Enter your total earned income from Part 4, line 4b."
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: subtract_floor0, from: eic.wsb_4b, take: {const: 0}}
    cite: "i1040gi (2025; 2026-02-25), pp. 47–48, Worksheet B, lines 4b–6."

  - id: eic.h_a0
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Look up the amount on line 1 in the EIC Table."
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: table_lookup, table: eic_0, key: eic.line1, status: f1040.status}
    cite: "i1040gi (2025; 2026-02-25), pp. 46 and 49–60."
  - id: eic.h_a1
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Look up the amount on line 1 in the EIC Table."
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: table_lookup, table: eic_1, key: eic.line1, status: f1040.status}
    cite: "i1040gi (2025; 2026-02-25), pp. 46 and 49–60."
  - id: eic.h_a2
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Look up the amount on line 1 in the EIC Table."
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: table_lookup, table: eic_2, key: eic.line1, status: f1040.status}
    cite: "i1040gi (2025; 2026-02-25), pp. 46 and 49–60."
  - id: eic.h_a3
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Look up the amount on line 1 in the EIC Table."
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: table_lookup, table: eic_3, key: eic.line1, status: f1040.status}
    cite: "i1040gi (2025; 2026-02-25), pp. 46 and 49–60."
  - id: eic.h_a_lookup
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Use the correct column for your filing status and the number of qualifying children you have who have valid SSNs."
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr:
      op: choose
      alternatives:
        - guard: {op: test, eq: [eic.h_ssn_children, {const: 0, type: Count}]}
          then: eic.h_a0
        - guard: {op: test, eq: [eic.h_ssn_children, {const: 1, type: Count}]}
          then: eic.h_a1
        - guard: {op: test, eq: [eic.h_ssn_children, {const: 2, type: Count}]}
          then: eic.h_a2
        - guard: {op: test, ge: [eic.h_ssn_children, {const: 3, type: Count}]}
          then: eic.h_a3
    cite: "i1040gi (2025; 2026-02-25), p. 46, Worksheet A, line 2."
  - id: eic.h_g0
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Look up the amount on line 3 in the EIC Table."
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: table_lookup, table: eic_0, key: eic.line3, status: f1040.status}
    cite: "i1040gi (2025; 2026-02-25), pp. 46, 48–60."
  - id: eic.h_g1
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Look up the amount on line 3 in the EIC Table."
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: table_lookup, table: eic_1, key: eic.line3, status: f1040.status}
    cite: "i1040gi (2025; 2026-02-25), pp. 46, 48–60."
  - id: eic.h_g2
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Look up the amount on line 3 in the EIC Table."
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: table_lookup, table: eic_2, key: eic.line3, status: f1040.status}
    cite: "i1040gi (2025; 2026-02-25), pp. 46, 48–60."
  - id: eic.h_g3
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Look up the amount on line 3 in the EIC Table."
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: table_lookup, table: eic_3, key: eic.line3, status: f1040.status}
    cite: "i1040gi (2025; 2026-02-25), pp. 46, 48–60."
  - id: eic.h_agi_lookup
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Use the correct column for your filing status and the number of qualifying children you have who have valid SSNs."
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr:
      op: choose
      alternatives:
        - guard: {op: test, eq: [eic.h_ssn_children, {const: 0, type: Count}]}
          then: eic.h_g0
        - guard: {op: test, eq: [eic.h_ssn_children, {const: 1, type: Count}]}
          then: eic.h_g1
        - guard: {op: test, eq: [eic.h_ssn_children, {const: 2, type: Count}]}
          then: eic.h_g2
        - guard: {op: test, ge: [eic.h_ssn_children, {const: 3, type: Count}]}
          then: eic.h_g3
    cite: "i1040gi (2025; 2026-02-25), pp. 46 and 48, Worksheet A line 5 and Worksheet B line 10."
  - id: eic.h_b0
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Look up the amount on line 6 above in the EIC Table to find the credit."
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: table_lookup, table: eic_0, key: eic.wsb_6, status: f1040.status}
    cite: "i1040gi (2025; 2026-02-25), pp. 48–60."
  - id: eic.h_b1
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Look up the amount on line 6 above in the EIC Table to find the credit."
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: table_lookup, table: eic_1, key: eic.wsb_6, status: f1040.status}
    cite: "i1040gi (2025; 2026-02-25), pp. 48–60."
  - id: eic.h_b2
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Look up the amount on line 6 above in the EIC Table to find the credit."
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: table_lookup, table: eic_2, key: eic.wsb_6, status: f1040.status}
    cite: "i1040gi (2025; 2026-02-25), pp. 48–60."
  - id: eic.h_b3
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Look up the amount on line 6 above in the EIC Table to find the credit."
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: table_lookup, table: eic_3, key: eic.wsb_6, status: f1040.status}
    cite: "i1040gi (2025; 2026-02-25), pp. 48–60."
  - id: eic.h_b_lookup
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Use the correct column for your filing status and the number of qualifying children you have who have valid SSNs."
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr:
      op: choose
      alternatives:
        - guard: {op: test, eq: [eic.h_ssn_children, {const: 0, type: Count}]}
          then: eic.h_b0
        - guard: {op: test, eq: [eic.h_ssn_children, {const: 1, type: Count}]}
          then: eic.h_b1
        - guard: {op: test, eq: [eic.h_ssn_children, {const: 2, type: Count}]}
          then: eic.h_b2
        - guard: {op: test, ge: [eic.h_ssn_children, {const: 3, type: Count}]}
          then: eic.h_b3
    cite: "i1040gi (2025; 2026-02-25), p. 48, Worksheet B, line 7."
  - id: eic.h_b_line7
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Enter the credit here."
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr:
      op: choose
      alternatives:
        - guard: {op: test, lt: [eic.wsb_6, {param: eic.table_start}]}
          then: eic.h_zero
        - guard: {op: test, ge: [eic.wsb_6, {param: eic.table_start}]}
          then: eic.h_b_lookup
    cite: "i1040gi (2025; 2026-02-25), pp. 48–49, Worksheet B line 7 and first EIC Table row."
    note: "As for Worksheet A line 2, zero is used below the first printed table row of $1."

  - id: eic.h_below_threshold
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Is the amount on line 3 less than the applicable amount?"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      any:
        - op: test
          all:
            - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_ssn_children, {const: 0, type: Count}]}
            - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_joint, {const: false}]}
            - {op: test, lt: [eic.line3, {param: eic.ws_threshold0.other}]}
        - op: test
          all:
            - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_ssn_children, {const: 0, type: Count}]}
            - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_joint, {const: true}]}
            - {op: test, lt: [eic.line3, {param: eic.ws_threshold0.joint}]}
        - op: test
          all:
            - {op: test, gt: [eic.h_ssn_children, {const: 0, type: Count}]}
            - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_joint, {const: false}]}
            - {op: test, lt: [eic.line3, {param: eic.ws_threshold1.other}]}
        - op: test
          all:
            - {op: test, gt: [eic.h_ssn_children, {const: 0, type: Count}]}
            - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_joint, {const: true}]}
            - {op: test, lt: [eic.line3, {param: eic.ws_threshold1.joint}]}
    cite: "i1040gi (2025; 2026-02-25), pp. 46 and 48, Worksheet A line 5 and Worksheet B line 10."
  - id: eic.h_a_continue
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "If line 2 is zero, you can’t take the credit."
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      all:
        - {op: test, eq: [eic.eligible, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [eic.self_employed, {const: false}]}
        - {op: test, gt: [eic.line2, {const: 0}]}
    cite: "i1040gi (2025; 2026-02-25), p. 46, Worksheet A, before you begin and line 2."
  - id: eic.h_a_use_agi
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Look up the amount on line 3 in the EIC Table to find the credit."
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      all:
        - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_a_continue, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [eic.line4, {const: false}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_below_threshold, {const: false}]}
    cite: "i1040gi (2025; 2026-02-25), p. 46, Worksheet A, lines 4–5."
  - id: eic.h_a_min
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Enter the smaller amount on line 6."
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: smaller_of, of: [eic.line5, eic.line2]}
    cite: "i1040gi (2025; 2026-02-25), p. 46, Worksheet A, line 5."
  - id: eic.h_b_continue
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "If line 7 is zero, you can’t take the credit."
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      all:
        - {op: test, eq: [eic.eligible, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [eic.self_employed, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, gt: [eic.h_b_line7, {const: 0}]}
    cite: "i1040gi (2025; 2026-02-25), pp. 47–48, Worksheet B, lines 4b–7."
  - id: eic.h_b_use_agi
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Look up the amount on line 8 in the EIC Table to find the credit."
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      all:
        - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_b_continue, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, ne: [eic.line3, eic.wsb_6]}
        - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_below_threshold, {const: false}]}
    cite: "i1040gi (2025; 2026-02-25), p. 48, Worksheet B, lines 8–10."
    note: "Worksheet B line 8 and Worksheet A line 3 copy the same Form 1040 line 11b."
  - id: eic.h_b_min
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Enter the smaller amount on line 11."
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: smaller_of, of: [eic.h_agi_lookup, eic.h_b_line7]}
    cite: "i1040gi (2025; 2026-02-25), p. 48, Worksheet B, line 10."
  - id: eic.h_b_credit
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "This is your earned income credit."
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr:
      op: choose
      alternatives:
        - guard: {op: test, eq: [eic.h_b_continue, {const: false}]}
          then: eic.h_zero
        - guard:
            op: test
            all:
              - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_b_continue, {const: true}]}
              - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_b_use_agi, {const: false}]}
          then: eic.h_b_line7
        - guard:
            op: test
            all:
              - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_b_continue, {const: true}]}
              - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_b_use_agi, {const: true}]}
          then: eic.h_b_min
    cite: "i1040gi (2025; 2026-02-25), p. 48, Worksheet B, lines 7–11."
```
